historical_full_regression.reason: The build container cannot git-clone the GitHub repository and blocks downloading raw Python test files by derived MIME type, so the exact historical suite could not be materialized. Focused and cross-node source-derived tests are reported separately; no full-suite pass claim is made.

external_target_integration.reason: No external DB endpoint/credential was available; v0.22.7 intentionally performs no TARGET mutation.

native_windows_integration.reason: Linux build host; registry/runtime parity only.
